title: Werewolf transformed my old gadgets into USB-C powered ones
summary: You plug the $8 Werewolf VFLEX dongle into your phone to program it, plug it into your USB charger or battery, then attach a $4 barrel jack tip. Tap that charger, hit “Update” to program the dongle, then plug everything in correctly.
